name: Nasser Al Qasabi
bio: Nasser Qassim Al Qasabi (Arabic: ناصر قاسم القصبي‎) is a well-known Saudi Arabian actor. He started his acting career in 1984 and is mostly known for his various roles in the series No Big Deal (Arabic: طاش ما طاش) In 2012, Nasser became one of the three judges on the television series, Arabs Got Talent.

credits.title: 7 Dogs
credits.overview: Interpol agent Khalid Al-Azzazi joins forces with Ghali Abu Dawood from the 7 Dogs crime syndicate to fight drug trafficking.

credits.title: Al Theeb Fi Al Gleeb
credits.overview: In a comic framework, an accountant is accused of embezzlement and finds himself forced to facing his family members ’contradictory positions on the case while trying to prove his innocence.

credits.title: Understand Me
credits.overview: About Nasser, who used to travel and live freely, then he thinks to get married from his friend’s daughter but he has hampered by impossible conditions set by her father so, Nasser returns to travel and forget the idea of marriage.
